title: He parked it perfectly.
idea: Friends try to 09 (18 Nov 2026): Dad's new car, three tries to park; Wedge's 'trust me' bins it, Chip dives in diagonal, Spud parks it in one move; Wedge's proud pat rolls it back to the start: 4/3

hook.what: Dad's new car half in a parking gap at a bad angle, its tyre bumping the kerb; TRY 1/3

do.style: deep, serious storyteller, brisk and clear, a little ominous

do.reason: the back tyre squeaking up the kerb stone
the tyre dropping off the kerb

do.style: loud, confident, cheerful, waving a car back

do.reason: the bumper bonks the plastic wheelie bin
the bin lands on its side on the pavement

do.style: flat, calm, bored, not looking up from his phone

do.reason: tyres as Chip pulls off too fast
the tyre kissing the kerb, softly
the big major chord as they cheer
the pat on the car's door
the car creaks as it starts to roll
tyres slowly rolling back over the cobbles
the back tyre bumping up onto the kerb

visible.why: frame 0: Dad's new car half in the gap at a bad angle; Chip driving, Wedge waving
Wedge waving the car back: trust me, back, back, back
the bumper bonks the bin over; the counter goes to 2/3
Mash, on his phone in the back: Nice.
Chip dives in nose first and stops diagonal across the gap
last try: Spud calmly sets the mirror
one smooth reverse into the gap
they cheer in front of the perfectly parked car
Wedge's proud pat: Trust me. Good car.
the car rolls back out of the gap with Mash still on his phone
two glares at Wedge, the car back at its frame-0 angle, 4/3
